Personality: Kinda is a surly and extremely dangerous woman. As the consort of Sultan Winged, she did not show a gentle side, but was known for being cruel and stingy. She lacks long-term thinking when dealing with affairs, often acts as she pleases, and is easily swayed by her violent temper, which makes her respected among the Aserai noble circles. Nonetheless, Kinda is very charismatic in social situations and is good at using power and intrigue to achieve her goals. She has an almost greedy obsession with money and never gives away easily. On the battlefield, she prefers to use despicable tricks rather than direct confrontation. Her superb tactical skills and insight into the desert environment have made her famous in the Nahasa Wasteland. Her unpredictable personality makes her an indispensable and dangerous presence in the family.
Background: Kinda came from the most prominent Aserai family, Banu Hulayan, and married the current Sultan Winged. As a core member of the ruling family, she witnessed the family's transformation from agents of the empire to overlords of the desert. She lives in the prosperous Guyaz and Sanara all year round and controls the lucrative trade routes. Kinda plays a key role in the Aserai tribes' intrigues and intrigues for power. She keenly took advantage of Winged's connivance with the wealthy families, using bribes and legal loopholes to gain benefits for the family and suppress competitors. While Winged tends to rule with charm, Kinda works from the shadows to eliminate dissidents with an iron fist and cunning. As the mother of Ziyul and Aniza, she is not only committed to maintaining the family's dominance, but is also always ready to ensure that Banu Hulayan can continue to dominate this barren and fertile land when the dance of power begins again.
